paragraphs: In mainland China, employment as an assistant, formal registration as a trainee for admission to practice and holding a lawyer’s practice certificate are three different statuses. A vacancy labeled “internship” or passing the legal qualification exam does not establish formal registration. Under the national bar association’s rules, the formal internship starts when the internship certificate is issued; check the local bar’s procedures. Article 16 of the current Lawyers Law restricts providing services in a lawyer’s name without a practice certificate and preserves statutory exceptions for litigation representation or defense. Article 23 of the bar association’s rules bars formally registered trainees from independently handling lawyer matters, signing representation or legal counsel agreements or issuing legal documents in a lawyer’s name, and presenting arguments in that capacity. Authorized help with submission, where the procedure permits it, is distinct from signing or issuing a document.
Use P-17 for the evidence index, discrepancy note and review questions. Compare with the reference and keep the signing date unknown.

locale_requirements.jurisdiction: Keep U.S. occupational materials separate from Chinese practice rules.
locale_requirements.summary: BLS lists an associate degree or a paralegal studies certificate as typical U.S. entry routes. Some employers prefer a bachelor’s degree or may accept high school plus experience. The ABA defines paralegal work as delegated substantive legal work for which a lawyer is responsible. Check local rules separately. In mainland China, employment as an assistant, formal registration as a trainee for admission to practice and holding a lawyer’s practice certificate are three different statuses. A vacancy labeled “internship” or passing the legal qualification exam does not establish formal registration. Under the national bar association’s rules, the formal internship starts when the internship certificate is issued; check the local bar’s procedures. Article 16 of the current Lawyers Law restricts providing services in a lawyer’s name without a practice certificate and preserves statutory exceptions for litigation representation or defense. Article 23 of the bar association’s rules bars formally registered trainees from independently handling lawyer matters, signing representation or legal counsel agreements or issuing legal documents in a lawyer’s name, and presenting arguments in that capacity. Authorized help with submission, where the procedure permits it, is distinct from signing or issuing a document.
